author: A. I. Mccann
title: Pasco deputies search for missing man last seen in New Port Richey
text:
Chris Nocco, Pasco County Sheriff | https://www.pascosheriff.com/
Chris Nocco, Pasco County Sheriff | https://www.pascosheriff.com/
Pasco County Sheriff's deputies are searching for John Malley, a 22-year-old who has been reported missing and endangered. Malley is described as being 6 feet 2 inches tall, weighing about 165 pounds, with brown hair and brown eyes. He was last seen on March 2 at approximately 10:50 p.m. in the Rowan Road area of New Port Richey.
Authorities do not know what clothing Malley was wearing when he was last seen. It is believed that he may be driving a silver 2001 Toyota 4Runner with Florida license plate CJ0AG.
The Pasco County Sheriff's Office urges anyone with information about Malley's location to contact their Non-Emergency Line at 727-847-8102, option 7. Tips can also be submitted online through the sheriff's office website at http://PascoSheriff.com/tips.
